g.text: USGS logged 3,996 earthquakes of magnitude 6 or more since 2000. Ranked by the energy they released,

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Inter'; fill: #4a4741

g.text: the top four account for 49% of it. The other 3,992 share the rest.

g.text: NOTE Energy from log10(E) = 1.5M + 4.8. Quakes under M6 are left out; each step down in magnitude

g.text: is about 32x less energy but only about 10x as common, so they add little.
